name: quiescent-current
description: Quiescent current at no load and full load, plus shutdown Iq, all in one op point
claim: README.md Target specification, 'Iq (excluding load current)' row (DR-0004 amendment A6): < 30 uA at no load and at full load, binding ff/125C/3.63V; the < 10 uA stretch is not separately gated. Also substantiates the 'Enable / shutdown' row's (A9) shutdown-Iq clause: < 3 uA at the same binding corner (the row's other clauses -- monotonic disable, Vin->Vout leakage -- are #11's shutdown-circuit characterization, not this experiment's scope). This record supersedes 20260801-003015-b64d60e -- a stale record from an earlier design state (commit b64d60e, before #39's current-limit/shutdown path and #44's soft-start landed) whose own stored iq_full_ua values are physically sane; the append-only rule means that record is not itself in error and is left untouched. Re-running this SAME testbench topology against the CURRENT (post-#39/#44) ldo_core.spice with a cold, all-zero-guess Newton-Raphson start does not reproduce those sane numbers, for the reason root-caused in #40 and fixed here. The _full instance's ideal 50 mA current sink had a second, unphysical DC solution in which the pass device is off and the sink holds VOUT_FULL tens of volts BELOW ground, drawing its current through forward-biased substrate junctions in the PDK device models, and a cold Newton-Raphson start reached it. Only the _full instance has a load sink, so it is the only one that introduces the second solution -- but the contamination was NOT confined to it. Hand-checked at tt_27c_3.30v (#46): with the old ideal sink the deck reports vout_full = -28.65 V and iq_full_ua = -7.79 uA (a negative Iq that silently PASSed the upper-bound-only check), and the sibling _en instance is off the physical solution too -- vout_en = 1.014 V with xdut_en.fb = 0.677 V, i.e. the feedback node nowhere near the 1.2 V VREF it must regulate to, reporting iq_en_ua = 17.44 uA. All three instances are solved by one Newton iteration over one matrix, so the pathological branch drags its deck-mates off the physical root with it. With the compliance-limited sink the same corner gives vout_full = 1.79945 V, vout_en = 1.79945 V, xdut_en.fb = 1.19964 V, vout_dis = 0.13 mV with loop_dis at VIN (pass device off), iq_en_ua = 13.78 uA and iq_dis_ua = 2.2e-4 uA -- every branch physical. The _en and _dis instances and their measure expressions are themselves unchanged by this fix; what changed is that the deck they share now has only one solution. The sink is now compliance-limited (see tb_quiescent.spice and sim/harness/README.md, 'Compliance-limited load sinks'): it draws its commanded current for VOUT_FULL well above ground and nothing at or below ground, which is what any real load does, and which deletes the unphysical solution rather than biasing the solver away from it. iload_full_ma below measures the actually-delivered load current, which is load-bearing here because iq_full_ua subtracts the injected 50 mA back out. No ratified threshold was changed.

operating_conditions.load_current: 0 mA external for the enabled/disabled states; 50 mA for the 'full load' state, commanded through a compliance-limited sink (Vilc/Bload_full/Vlmeas_full), verified by iload_full_ma, and subtracted back out of iq_full_ua per the row's 'excluding load current' clause
operating_conditions.output_cap: N/A -- DC op-point only, no output network in this deck (Iq is a DC claim; a cap is inert at DC)
operating_conditions.enable_state: three states captured in one op point: enabled/no-load (iq_en_ua, the primary Iq claim), disabled/shutdown (iq_dis_ua, Enable/shutdown row clause), enabled/50mA (iq_full_ua, the Iq row's 'at full load' clause)

iq_en_ua.description: README.md Iq target, no load (< 30 uA; < 10 uA stretch not separately gated)

iq_dis_ua.description: README.md Enable/shutdown row: shutdown Iq < 3 uA

iq_full_ua.description: README.md Iq target, full load (50 mA, excluded from the measurement)

iload_full_ma.description: Harness integrity, not a ratified spec line: the compliance-limited sink must deliver the commanded 50 mA (see Claim) -- iq_full_ua subtracts this current back out, so a shortfall here would fabricate the Iq number

vout_full_v.description: Harness integrity, not a ratified spec line (the ratified accuracy row is sim/mc-output-accuracy's): asserts the _full instance settled on the physical solution, not the sub-ground root #40 found
